Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.

Repeat from step 2.

Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Bloodghast

2511-2728-4153-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2511-2728-4153-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2511-2728-4153-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 4.

824-2728-3967-4153.easyPrerequisites:

When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 4.

2438-6566--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.

If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Tenacious Tomeseeker and Ministrant of Obligation, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.

Resolve the Ministrant of Obligation trigger, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.

When Tenacious Tomeseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Back for Seconds from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.

Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Vesuvan Shapeshifter into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Vesuvan Shapeshifter to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.
